scope: Primary paging touch and controlled-owner cohort only. This advances an OPEN cell and preserves every original criterion, failure and passing-cell receipt. It does not close the whole behavior cell.
unchangedOriginalRequirements: All 30 canonical root cases, full 131760-case window oracle, approved current caller page/size authority, all inherited child/field/collection/overlay/native contracts, existing case/process limits, old failures and physical deferrals remain required and unchanged.
isolation: No Button, ComboBox, Typeahead, Stepper, Slider, sort/filter, editor-component source or shared/root harness edits. Existing Pagination page-entry/size-field logic is reused unchanged and not exercised as a substitute for its required editor lane.

admission.source: Main binds full integration HEAD, actual source/SDK/product/input/profile tuple; a scene hash or environment variable alone does not prove a native outcome.
admission.beforeEachMethod: Prepare a fresh default Pagination scene in the matched Release product: page 3, size 10, echo/groups/left true; disabled/empty/rtl/veto false; requests and callbacks empty; keyboard inactive. Each method has its own admission. Do not run the class against leftover state.
admission.nativeExecution: Add the Swift source to the existing UI-test target and use standard -only-testing selection within main's existing native budget. Cloud starts no native build, simulator, test batch or process monitor.
admission.provenance: Input/observer manifests describe the planned cohort and instrument, not future evidence. Pair actual SDK event/object/receiver/window/lifetime records, target/descendant correspondence, current/disabled metadata and timing for every original contact after any normal activation. JavaScript scalar readbacks and XCTest snapshots do not replace those records.
admission.profile: Prepared iOS P01 normal portrait, keyboard-inactive genuine native touch. Remaining applicable profiles, keyboard-active cases, Android and physical modality obligations remain independent.

observations.owner: pagination-behavior-owner: complete current scene page/size/echo/disabled/empty/rtl/groups/left/veto/requests. No local page or size mirror is introduced.
observations.callbacks: pagination-behavior-callbacks: untruncated ordered sequence/kind/data/receivedAt rows. Public general-button onPress records original scalar payload then the existing page/size request callbacks append their values. receivedAt is JS observation time, not hardware input time.
observations.veto: The original public event's preventDefault is used only when explicitly armed. Observer neither persists nor retains nor injects native events. customGeneralButtonProps.isDisabled=false deliberately tests the authoritative global/edge guard.
observations.nativeVsSource: Ten source cases use normal userEvent gestures. The source-only veto case reuses the original Pagination oracle's public fireEvent event/prevention seam. The corresponding XCTest veto method uses one real target touch; source positives do not qualify installed behavior.
